pages.text: You've met everyone worth meeting. Now the best part. South of the village, on an islet of its own, stands the &6Wildgate&r, a great stone ring with a shimmering veil.
Walk through and you're in the &6survival world&r: forests, caves, villages, dungeons and monsters. That's where you really play. Skyhaven is your base. The wild is your work.
&6/hub&r brings you home whenever you like, and &6/survival&r takes you back to where you left off. Out there you'll find &6waystones&r, standing stones that let you travel. Mind the nights.
Take some torches. Go on through, and come home with stories. I'll keep the stew hot.
